experiments.task: Author only a dependency-free safe Rust implementation of pub fn bounded_chunk_end(text: &str, offset: usize, limit: usize) -> Option<usize>. Return None if limit is zero, offset exceeds the string byte length, or offset is not a UTF-8 boundary. Otherwise return the furthest UTF-8 boundary not exceeding the string byte length or offset plus the byte limit, without integer overflow. At end of input with positive limit return that end offset. If a nonempty remainder cannot fit a complete character, return None. Only function items; no imports, macros, attributes, unsafe, I/O, subprocesses or environment access. Author the implementation yourself. The host separately evaluates the quarantined source against frozen acceptance; do not claim compilation, correctness or promotion.
criteria: Submit a quarantined candidate with exact native readback; independent host review is required before execution or promotion.
